basic_details.job_title: SMOI Young Professional Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 8 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Silk Mark Organisation of India (SMOI) is recruiting candidates for Young Professional - Extension Services posts, part of its total 8 vacancies announced for 2026. This engagement is purely on a temporary and contract basis up to 31 March 2029, with a specified monthly pay of Rs. 30,000 for the post. Candidates holding a Diploma in Textiles/Bachelor's Textiles/Sericulture/Agriculture or any Degree are eligible to apply. how_to_apply: Visit the official recruitment website at https://silkmarkrecruitment.in.
Register online using a valid Mobile number and the generated OTP (One-Time Password) to verify your identity.
Fill out the online application form and select the State where you can be engaged, applying for one chapter only.
Upload relevant documents in respect of age, qualifications, experience, etc., for office records.
Submit the online application on or before 23:59 PM on 28 October 2026.
Take a printout of the finally submitted online application and keep it along with uploaded documents for submission at the time of the interview.
important_instructions: Applications received through any other mode will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected. Candidates engaged in any other private/Government services/institutes/organisation must submit a No Objection Certificate/relieving letter from the parent employer at the time of joining. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification, though female candidates are encouraged to apply to reflect gender balance. The engagement is purely on a temporary and contract basis up to 31.03.2029 and does not confer any right or claim for regular or temporary appointment in any future vacancies. Office timings are generally from Monday to Saturday, 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM, with extended service rendered during exigencies. Selected candidates are eligible for all SMOI holidays and 8 days of leave per year on specific advance request subject to sanction. Selected candidates must be ready to undertake tours to areas under the jurisdiction of chapters as directed. Selected candidates must join within a maximum period of 30 days from the date of e-mailing the offer of engagement letter.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There are a total of 8 vacancies across 6 major cities and chapters as detailed below:

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Textiles/Bachelor's Textiles/Sericulture/Agriculture or any Degree. Candidates hailing from the concerned State will be eligible to apply for vacancies in the concerned chapter as local candidates. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Young Professionals will receive a consolidated stipend of Rs. 30,000/- per month. Professional tax will be deducted at source before effecting payment as per prevailing rules. TA/DA is allowed for official travel in the country subject to approval by the Competent Authority, with permissible modes of journey being Rail/Bus, and hotel accommodation, conveyance, and other allowances on par with level-3 cadre.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SMOI Young Professional - Extension Services
content_sections.text: Visit the official recruitment website at https://silkmarkrecruitment.in . Register online using a valid Mobile number and the generated OTP (One-Time Password) to verify your identity. Fill out the online application form and select the State where you can be engaged, applying for one chapter only. Upload relevant documents in respect of age, qualifications, experience, etc., for office records. Submit the online application on or before 23:59 PM on 28 October 2026. Take a printout of the finally submitted online application and keep it along with uploaded documents for submission at the time of the interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on merit, and shortlisted candidates will be intimated by e-mail communication only. Interviews will be conducted at selected locations/chapters with a 1:5 ratio (i.e., for every 1 position, 5 candidates will be invited for the interview). No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received through any other mode will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected. Candidates engaged in any other private/Government services/institutes/organisation must submit a No Objection Certificate/relieving letter from the parent employer at the time of joining. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification, though female candidates are encouraged to apply to reflect gender balance. The engagement is purely on a temporary and contract basis up to 31.03.2029 and does not confer any right or claim for regular or temporary appointment in any future vacancies. Office timings are generally from Monday to Saturday, 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM, with extended service rendered during exigencies. Selected candidates are eligible for all SMOI holidays and 8 days of leave per year on specific advance request subject to sanction. Selected candidates must be ready to undertake tours to areas under the jurisdiction of chapters as directed. Selected candidates must join within a maximum period of 30 days from the date of e-mailing the offer of engagement letter.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SMOI Young Professional recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is 28 October 2026 up to 23:59 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 8 vacancies have been announced for Young Professional - Extension Services posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the monthly stipend for SMOI Young Professionals?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated stipend of Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. What educational qualification is required to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Diploma in Textiles/Bachelor's Textiles/Sericulture/Agriculture or any Degree.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must not be more than 30 years of age as on 31.01.2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is this position permanent or on a contract basis?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely on a temporary and contract basis from the date of engagement up to 31 March 2029.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply for more than one chapter?
faq.answer: No, candidates must apply for one chapter only.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for the position?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted based on merit and invited for an interview at selected locations/chapters in a 1:5 ratio.
